meta.name: storyboard
meta.description: Create a six-frame storyboard that shows a user's journey from problem to solution. Use when you need a fast narrative for alignment, concept reviews, or demos.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用六格故事板快速呈现用户从问题到解决的旅程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在团队中快速对齐用户故事或概念方案
copy.tagline_en: Create a six-frame storyboard showing a user's journey from problem to solution
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly align user stories or concepts with your team

howto.what: Claude 会引导你回答 7 个问题，然后生成一个 6 格故事板，展示用户从问题到解决方案的旅程。每格包含文字描述和视觉建议（如简笔画风格）。
howto.when: 当你需要快速创建叙事来对齐团队、评审概念或演示时。例如，在讨论用户问题或产品方案时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个故事板：一位忙碌的护士发现自动排班系统。
say.note: Claude 会询问角色细节并生成 6 格故事。

say.text: 为我们的新功能创建一个 6 格故事板，主角是 Sarah。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成故事板步骤。

howto.what_en: Claude will ask you 7 questions, then generate a 6-frame storyboard showing a user's journey from problem to solution. Each frame includes text description and visual suggestions (e.g., sharpie sketches).
howto.when_en: Use when you need a fast narrative for alignment, concept reviews, or demos. Triggered when discussing user problems or product solutions.

say_en.text: Create a storyboard: a busy nurse discovers our auto-scheduling system.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for character details and generate 6 frames.

say_en.text: Make a 6-frame storyboard for our new feature, starring Sarah.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through the storyboard steps.
